Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the Eldrazi.
Lightning Greaves's ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the Eldrazi from exile by paying {0} due to Eye of Ugin.
Repeat.

Activate Maskwood Nexus by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
Deal combat damage with Wanderwine Prophets.
Wanderwine Prophets triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Changeling token and take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
Wanderwine Prophet does not have summoning sickness.
Wanderwine Prophets cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature, adding {R}.
The sacrificed creature's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
The Great Henge triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to draw a card.
The -1/-1 and +1/+1 counters are removed as a state-based action.
Repeat.

Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat.
If you control a creature with power 5 or greater, this combo nets infinite colored mana.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
Crab Umbra attached to Selvala.
You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.

Resolve Lightning Greaves's ability, attaching it to Cephalid Aristrocrat.
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Repeat.

feature.name: Near-infinite untap of some creatures you control

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Greater Good by sacrificing another creature with power one or greater.
If the creature was a Tentacle, The Watcher triggers, untapping up to one Kraken you control and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Greater Good ability, causing you to draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power and then discard three cards.
For each card drawn this way, The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating that many 1/1 Tentacle creature tokens.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
You control at least one other creature with power one or greater.

When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

Activate Selvala by tapping it and paying {G}, adding {W}{G} and three mana of any color.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Selvala.

Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

Cast the instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Stella Lee by tapping it, copying the instant or sorcery.
Resolve the copy of the instant or sorcery, untapping Stella Lee.
Repeat from step 2.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:

almostIncludedByAddingColors.notes: Moritte can only be your commander if the sources from both templates fit within its commander identity.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Cast Moritte either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{U}{U} plus commander tax if applicable. Choose to have it enter as a copy of the persist creature that is still legendary.
Put Moritte into your graveyard due to the legend rule. When it dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its ability. Choose to have it enter as a copy of the persist creature that is still legendary.
Repeat step 2.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature is your Ring-bearer.
